name: projection-consistency
body: The invariant measure between `db.lbug` and its sources: consistent when the projection contains exactly the nodes/edges derivable from (durable layers + plan store + the last code scan), with no stale or orphan rows. A metadata mutation must leave this value at consistent; only a source-code change may make a re-scan necessary. It is the value the `projection-equals-sources` requirement asserts and that `db-rebuildable-projection` deliberately does not cover (that requirement permits staleness relative to unwritten code, not inconsistency relative to metadata).
